stalls.name: Auntie Mei
stalls.persona: A warm, chatty grandmother who has sold fruit at the same wet market for 30 years. Calls customers 'my dear'. Soft on compliments, hates being rushed, secretly loves a good haggle.

greet: Morning my dear! This {item} very sweet one, {price} only.
Aiyo come come, fresh {item} today! {price}, good price already.
counter: {offer} ah? Aiyo... OK lah, {price} for you.
Cannot {offer} lah, my dear. {price}, I already very kind.
final: {price} really last price already. Auntie also must eat one.
Aiyo, {price} cannot go lower already lah.
insulted: {offer}?! You want auntie close shop is it?
Wah lau, {offer}... you joking with me?
accept: OK lah OK lah, {price}! Take, take. Come again ah!
Deal! {price}, my dear. Eat slowly, very sweet one.
flattered: Hehe, you so sweet talk. OK, {price} for you.
Wah, you got good taste! Fine, {price} lah.
flattery_tired: Sweet talk cannot pay rent, my dear.
Aiyo, stop praising already, just buy lah.
competitor_drop: Aiya, that stall's one not as sweet... OK, {price}.
They cheaper ah? Hmm... {price}, don't tell people.
competitor_annoyed: Then you go buy from them lor!
Their {item} old one leh. My price still {price}.
bulk: Buy two ah? OK, {price} each, happy?
Wah, buy more! Then {price} each lah.
regular: Eh, I remember your face! OK, {price} for regular.
Regular customer must take care. {price} lah.
smalltalk: Hot today hor? Buy fruit cool down. Still {price}.
My grandson also like this one. {price} ah.
rude: Eh, talk nicely leh. Auntie old already.
Wah, so rude. I don't want to sell you already.
callback: Eh eh, come back! OK lah, {price}!
letgo: OK lor, bye bye. Next time come again.
Never mind, other customer will buy.
refuse: Aiyo, tired already. Come back another day lah.
Auntie no mood already. Next time ah.
confused: Huh? How much you want to pay ah?

stalls.name: Uncle Lim
stalls.persona: A gruff fishmonger of few words, very proud that his fish is the freshest in the market. Not moved by flattery, respects people who know their fish, gets annoyed by 'the other stall is cheaper'.

insulted: Haiz. {offer}, you buy ikan bilis can.
flattery_tired: Talk so much, fish also not cheaper.
competitor_annoyed: Then go there lor. Their fish yesterday one.

stalls.name: Boss Raj
stalls.persona: A cheerful, fast-talking night-market gadget seller who calls everyone 'boss'. Loves bundles and repeat customers, enjoys the haggle as a game, almost always calls you back.

counter: {offer} ah boss? Aiyo... {price}, special for you!
Boss, {price} lah. I also need to eat.
final: {price}, boss, any lower I lose money.
insulted: {offer}?! Boss, you want to bankrupt me ah?
Haha boss, {offer} can buy kopi only.
flattered: Haha, boss also very smart! OK {price}.
Wah boss know good stuff. {price} for you.
flattery_tired: Boss, compliments cannot charge phone leh.
Hahaha OK OK, now buy lah boss.
competitor_drop: Their one fake one, boss! But OK, {price}.
Aiyo boss, OK lah, I match: {price}.
competitor_annoyed: Go check boss, theirs sure spoil. Mine {price}.
bulk: Two ah! Boss very generous! {price} each!
regular: Boss! Long time no see! {price} for you.
smalltalk: Boss, night market crowded tonight hor? {price}.
Boss, you want screen protector also? This one {price}.
rude: Boss, no need so fierce lah.
letgo: OK boss, next time come again!
Bye boss, I keep one for you.
refuse: Boss, I tired already. Tomorrow come.

stalls.name: Kak Siti
stalls.persona: A cheerful bazaar stallholder who makes her own kueh and sells batik scarves. Calls customers 'adik'. Proud of her handmade work, warms up to regulars and polite customers, firm but kind.

counter: Aiyo adik, {price} lah, I make by hand.
insulted: {offer}?! Adik, the cloth also more than that!
flattery_tired: Sweet mouth only ah? Buy lah.
competitor_drop: Their one machine-made, adik. But OK, {price}.
competitor_annoyed: Then adik go there lor. Mine still {price}.
regular: Eh adik, you came last week right? {price} for you.
smalltalk: My mother taught me this recipe. {price}.
letgo: OK adik, see you next time.
refuse: Sorry adik, I need to serve others.

competitor: Other stall gave me better price.
regular: I come every week one leh!
Remember me? I always buy here!
